parole.testo: Of disputed origin, perhaps named for a small tribe of Komis who met the Russians, possibly related to the Uralic origin of Northern Khanty сӑран (săran, “Komi”).

Probably from a Uralic language, like Proto-Mansi *mē̮ŋ-ońt (“earth-horn”) combining Proto-Uralic *mëxe (“earth”) (compare Northern Mansi ма̄ (mā), Finnish maa) with *aŋtɜ (“horn”) (compare Northern Mansi а̄ньт (ānʹt, “horn”) – otherwise displaced in many branches by PU *śarwe cf.
